Historical FAIL/PARTIAL/NOT_VERIFIED, including untouched denied ABS-A2, are preserved and not relabelled PASS. Safety, cost, reference-stop, correct target, recovery and canonical completion remain required.

Current product e851cae0, candidate75dc0e3. C060 retains finite actual Primary recognition/context observations; C061 completes the actual same-label target clarification → selected Goal revision1→2 → displayed144-byte artifact/host receipt, with other Goal unchanged. Changed Primary and unchanged16 host/UI/Expert files are explicitly scoped in the audit; no universal language or new old-candidate PASS claim.

Implementation objective #12 is complete at this functional scope; release Issue#5 owns remaining actual whole-flow owner evaluation HR-STABLE1-001 and final release audit/closure. Fresh actual owner preview was opened on this Mac with empty DB, official Pro/extraOFF, at most16 calls and15-minute proof; no synthetic owner input or evaluation. Session expiry is operational, not a reason to infer evaluation. Development must recheck actual runtime before any later use and never auto-renew proof.

Next: reflect the actual overall owner-usefulness answer, diagnose only material actual functional blockers, complete final version/evidence/Issue audit and release Stable-1 if all required gates pass. No further prose-quality loop or artificial user testing quota. Parent#2/milestone1 and project#6 remain OPEN until their own objectives are met; Stable-1 is not overall PAL completion. P001/future stages remain unadopted; no new payment, auth, external action/publication, stopped-schedule restart or automatic-learning claim.

Goal: deliver useful natural Japanese local delegation through a reasoning-model Primary and bounded Expert, without making the user manage internal tasks.

Stable-0 remains released. Stable-1 is ACTIVE under D021, adopted P002 clarification, and the owner's latest model-led direction D028/D029. No new task/tool, external sending, payment/public exposure, automatic schedule or72h quota.

Current work: #12 has implemented model-led intent/target/answer selection and source-backed control/memory with host canonical validation. P003 form-only/wording approval wait is withdrawn. Rule-only historical implementations #3/#4 remain recorded; their evidence is not transferred to the new candidate. Qwen3.8-27B is the owner's model-performance reference; actual PAL qualification remains unproven.

Acceptance: every currently required N1 row under D031 in ACCEPTANCE.md, including N1-09 and N1-10, has candidate-bound evidence PASS; impacted S0/F0 regression, one actual owner end-to-end usefulness evaluation, final full suite/version/limits audit and private release. N1-07 awaits actual current whole-flow owner evaluation; N1-08 is PARTIAL pending that answer and release closure. N1-05 quality-only probes are nonrequired under D031 with historical failures retained. No micro-approval blocks implementation.

Work units:
- [x] #3 — historical lexical intake and independent corpus
- [x] #4 — historical safe control binding/recovery
- [x] #12 — reasoning-model Primary and bounded host commit
- [ ] #5 — final real UI/usefulness/release verification

Project: https://github.com/users/thattor/projects/1 ; overall goal #6. Each unit uses test → implementation → verification → evidence → commit/push → goal evaluation → next. Material unresolved changes to the goal/scope/cost/permission remain human decisions after required review; routine technical reasoning is autonomous. Future unadopted stages do not block this active scope. Source of truth: STATE.md / SPEC.md / DESIGN.md / ACCEPTANCE.md / DECISIONS.md.


C047 checkpoint (evidence 22418b9): HR-ACCESS-002 is resolved. The direct owner action was received and the same official SWE-2 High Free review completed with workspace trust respected (134.740s), after fresh existing-auth/Free checks. No new login/payment/global trust override. Official Opus C046 review and D029 C047 adoption precede implementation.

A test-only existing-fault-seam probe now proves actual controlled late-result fencing on candidate c44d3b4/product53a616: two frozen Japanese UI inputs, three actual native slots, same running Goal cancelled at epoch+1 and its Attempt fenced, exact matching stale-artifact rejection, zero accepted artifacts/receipts/outcomes/questions/approvals. Six-event fsync chain, read-only DB and source hashes independently verified. Normal closure200.824s/exit0; owned PID gone and port explicitly ECONNREFUSED.19 focused tests and268 full tests PASS24.048s. All17 product files unchanged.

Evidence: https://github.com/thattor/personal-agent-lab/blob/22418b983d91012760244f6bd3575170417b6da4/evidence/reviews/judgment-boundary/c047-controlled-cancel/README.md

Scope is controlled delivery after real Executor return, not upstream generation cancellation or natural timing reliability. Original C035/C045 timing results remain unchanged. C045 ABS-A1 and TARGET-A/B PASS retain their bindings; ABS-A2 NOT_VERIFIED after explicit browser-client block, nine artifact-dependent hosts NOT_RUN. C043 recognition proof remains unchanged-component evidence with original versions. No whole N1 or release promotion.

C047 next action (historical; current update below): resolve the actual browser access condition through a supported allowed path before remaining artifact-dependent frozen UI cases; no alternate content access, blind retry, proof renewal or new calls while blocked. Then one current-candidate whole-flow owner usefulness evaluation and final acceptance/version/limits audit. No repeated trust request or routine technical micro-question. Qwen3.8-27B remains the owner's capability reference; actual PAL qualification NOT_RUN. Stable0 released; Stable1 and overall PAL incomplete. No old quotas, stopped schedule restart, paid fallback or external exposure.

Material plan/scope/acceptance/priority change: Opus discuss/agreement → versioned proposal with evidence/delta/recommendation/affected vs independent work → actual targeted human decision → canonical docs/GitHub activation.
